metadata.warning: Zone geometries are APPROXIMATE, hand-estimated for UI/testing defaults centered on Sleaford. RAF Cranwell is active military airspace — do NOT use this file for real flight planning. Verify against CAA AIP / OpenAIP / NOTAM sources before operational use.

properties.name: Sleaford — Default Area of Interest
properties.notes: Non-restrictive reference bounding box used for default map centering and offline tile pre-seeding radius. Not an airspace restriction.

properties.name: RAF Cranwell ATZ/MATZ (approximate)
properties.notes: Active military airfield ~2.5nm radius approximation. Real MATZ geometry, stub masts, and NOTAM'd activity periods must be sourced from UK AIP ENR 5.2 / OpenAIP before use. HIGH PRIORITY for verification.

properties.name: RAF Digby (station active, runways non-active)
properties.notes: RAF Digby remains an active RAF station (ISTAR/comms role) but has no active flying operations or maintained runways. Excluded from runway heading indicators per airspace_manager.py non-active airfield list. Shown here for map context only.
